title: v17 rc.2/rc.3 verification — rollup of the 3 defects found (2 open, 1 fixed)
body:
Rollup of the defects found in the **rc.2 / rc.3** verification pass on #3909 — the window `2bafe62e8` → `a1a855a28` (277 non-release commits, 283 changesets, objectui pin `7d9734d5e321 → f5bc4c78be76`).

Supersedes #4482, which covered the rc.0/rc.1 passes and is closed along with all seventeen of its issues.

**3 defects. 2 open, 1 fixed and re-verified.**

Verified against a real showcase boot on `main` @ `06df4fa16`, two live principals, plus purpose-built probe stacks for the cases the showcase has no specimen for.

---

## Open

### #5086 — `allowRuntimeCreate: false` is not enforced

`PUT /meta` creates `job` and `agent` items that the metadata-type registry declares code-only:

```
PUT /api/v1/meta/job/rc3_j2
    {"name":"rc3_j2","label":"J","schedule":{"type":"cron","expression":"0 0 * * *"},"handler":"nope"}
→ 200 {"success":true,"message":"Saved customization overlay (env-wide) — type=job, name=rc3_j2"}
```

`handler: "nope"` names no function in any compiled bundle — exactly the record #4509 argues can never be scheduled, saved and reported as success. `agent`, the only other type carrying the flag, behaves the same. `supportsOverlay: false` looks equally unenforced: the success message calls the row a "customization overlay" for a type declared not to support them.

This is the ADR-0049 failure mode one level up — **the enforcement flag itself is the silently-inert declaration**. Easy to miss because a minimal payload 422s on schema validation first; only a payload that *passes* the schema reveals that the gate never runs. Studio presumably reads the flag to hide "create", so the UI honours a rule the API does not.

Re-confirmed on a fresh build after the #5088 fix landed — still reproduces.

### #5079 — a deleted overlay stays in the `/meta` listing

```
PUT    /api/v1/meta/action/rc3_a2   → 200,  listed,  dispatch 200
DELETE /api/v1/meta/action/rc3_a2   → 200 {"reset":true,"seq":N}
  GET  /api/v1/meta/action          → still listed        ❌
  POST /api/v1/actions/…/rc3_a2     → 404                 ✅
```

The delete is real — `reset: true` with a sequence number, no `sys_metadata` row, absent from `dist/objectstack.json`. Only the enumeration view is stale, so list and dispatch disagree about what exists. It is the mirror of the seam #4521 fixed on the write side (saved overlays became immediately dispatchable).

The #4432 headline harms — namespace normalisation, listing shadowing, immediate dispatch — are all fixed and verified; this is the surviving branch.

---

## Fixed and re-verified

### #5088 — `updateMany` ran hooks for a nonexistent id ✅

Fixed by `75bb3af56` (*by-id bulk writes refuse a row that names no record*). Re-verified on a freshly built `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`; all three branches the fix names now answer correctly:

| call | before | now |
|---|---|---|
| `updateMany` missing id | `INTERNAL_ERROR` (hook-condition abort) | `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` |
| atomic `[missing, valid]` | `["INTERNAL_ERROR","NOT_ATTEMPTED"]` | `["RECORD_NOT_FOUND","NOT_ATTEMPTED"]` |
| `deleteMany` missing id | — | `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` |

The batch no longer accuses a correct hook of naming an undeclared field, and under `atomic` the abort reason is now the caller's actual mistake.

---

## Verification state

#3909 stands at **110 / 113**. The three unticked items are:

- `job` code-artifact gate — blocked on **#5086** above.
- Two `changeset pre exit` close-out items — structurally impossible until the RC leaves pre-mode (npm `rc` dist-tag is still `17.0.0-rc.3`).

## Two testing traps worth recording

Both cost me a wrong conclusion in this pass; anyone re-testing this train should watch for them.

1. **A stale `dist/objectstack.json` fakes a platform failure.** An artifact from a previous day still carried two `apis` entries after the source moved to an empty array, so the showcase failed to boot on the new `apis:` rejection (#4936) and looked like a broken main. Delete the artifact before concluding anything about boot.
2. **Turbo cache hides a merged fix.** `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s `dist` predated the #5088 fix by hours while `src` contained it, so the defect "still reproduced" after a full `pnpm build`. Check `dist` mtime against the fix commit before reporting a fix as not landed.

Tracker: #3909.
